question: Which files across Thanos, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib would need to migrate their custom Appender implementations, wrappers, or consumers to the new AppenderV2 interface?

answer.summary: Prometheus introduced AppenderV2 (in storage/interface_append.go) consolidating Append, AppendHistogram, AppendExemplar, UpdateMetadata, and SetOptions into a single Append(ref, ls, st, t, v, h, fh, opts) method, with AppendableV2, AppenderTransaction, and LimitedAppenderV1 migration shim. The following files across the five downstream projects contain custom Appender V1 implementations, wrappers, or consumers that would need to migrate to AppenderV2.

custom_implementations_and_wrappers.reason: Defines ReceiveAppender struct embedding storage.Appender and implementing Append(ref, lset, t, v) with V1 signature. Also defines AppenderFactory interface returning (storage.Appender, error). Must migrate to AppenderV2 interface.
ReadyStorage.Appender() and adapter.Appender() both return storage.Appender. Must be updated to return AppenderV2 or AppendableV2.
Calls s.Appender(ctx) to get storage.Appender for Cap'n Proto receive path. Must migrate to AppenderV2.

consumers.reason: Prometheus.Appender() returns storage.Appender, used in test utilities to append samples. Must adopt AppenderV2.
appendFloatSamples, appendHistogramSamples, appendFloatHistogramSamples all accept storage.Appender parameter. Must migrate to AppenderV2.

thanos.note: Thanos has NOT yet adopted AppenderV2 anywhere in its non-vendor code.

custom_implementations_and_wrappers.reason: PusherAppender implements full V1 Appender interface (Append, AppendExemplar, AppendHistogram, UpdateMetadata, SetOptions). PusherAppendable.Appender() returns storage.Appender. NoopAppender also implements full V1 interface. All must migrate to AppenderV2.
MimirAppender.Append() already uses the V2 signature (ref, ls, ct, t, v, h, fh, opts). This is partially migrated but the surrounding code still uses storage.Appender type references.
Embeds storage.Appender in ingester appender struct. Must migrate to AppenderV2.
userTSDB.Appender() returns storage.Appender. Must be updated to AppenderV2/AppendableV2.
Embeds storage.Appender. Must migrate to AppenderV2.

consumers.reason: Defines AppendFunc type using storage.Appender. Must update to AppenderV2.
Uses storage.Appender for OTLP translation path.

mimir.note: Mimir has partially migrated (MimirAppender in otlpappender uses V2 signature) but most implementations still use V1.

custom_implementations_and_wrappers.reason: PusherAppender implements full V1 Appender (Append, AppendExemplar, UpdateMetadata, AppendHistogram, SetOptions) with explicit var _ storage.Appender assertion. PusherAppendable.Appender() returns storage.Appender. Must migrate to AppenderV2.

Contains V1 appender struct implementing full storage.Appender interface (Append, AppendExemplar, UpdateMetadata, AppendHistogram, SetOptions). Also has appenderV2Adapter wrapping V1 appender to satisfy AppenderV2, and Storage.AppenderV2() method. Partially migrated but V1 appender still needs full migration.
walRegistry.Appender() returns storage.Appender. notReadyAppender implements full V1 interface (Append, AppendExemplar, UpdateMetadata, AppendHistogram, SetOptions). Must migrate to AppenderV2.
Instance.Appender() returns storage.Appender. Also defines walStorage interface with AppenderV2(). Partially migrated but still exposes V1.
Defines interface with Appender(ctx) returning storage.Appender. Must update to AppenderV2.

loki.note: Loki has started migration with appenderV2Adapter in wal.go and AppenderV2() in instance.go, but most code still uses V1 interfaces.

custom_implementations_and_wrappers.reason: collectMetrics(appender storage.Appender, timeMs int64) uses V1 Appender to write counter metrics. Must migrate to AppenderV2.
collectMetrics(appender storage.Appender, timeMs int64) uses V1 Appender to write gauge metrics. Must migrate to AppenderV2.
collectMetrics(appender storage.Appender, timeMs int64) uses V1 Appender to write histogram metrics. Must migrate to AppenderV2.
collectMetrics, nativeHistograms, classicHistograms all accept storage.Appender. Must migrate to AppenderV2.
Defines metric interface with collectMetrics(appender storage.Appender, timeMs int64). Must update interface to AppenderV2.
storageImpl.Appender() returns storage.Appender. Must return AppenderV2.

test_files.reason: noopAppender and capturingAppender implement full V1 storage.Appender interface.
noopAppender and noopStorage implement V1 storage.Appender.

tempo.note: Tempo has NOT adopted AppenderV2 anywhere. All metrics generator code uses V1 Appender interface.

custom_implementations_and_wrappers.reason: appendable struct implements storage.Appendable with Appender() returning storage.Appender. Must migrate to AppendableV2 returning AppenderV2.
transaction struct implements full V1 storage.Appender (Append, AppendExemplar, AppendHistogram, UpdateMetadata, SetOptions). Core scrape-to-OTLP translation logic. Must migrate to AppenderV2.
Already references storage.AppendableV2 (line 291), showing partial awareness of V2, but still uses storage.Appendable. Needs full migration.

opentelemetry-collector-contrib.note: OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib has started acknowledging AppendableV2 in metrics_receiver.go but the core transaction and appendable implementations remain V1.

old_v1_interface_methods: Append(ref SeriesRef, l labels.Labels, t int64, v float64) (SeriesRef, error)
AppendHistogram(ref SeriesRef, l labels.Labels, t int64, h *histogram.Histogram, fh *histogram.FloatHistogram) (SeriesRef, error)
AppendExemplar(ref SeriesRef, l labels.Labels, e exemplar.Exemplar) (SeriesRef, error)
UpdateMetadata(ref SeriesRef, l labels.Labels, m metadata.Metadata) (SeriesRef, error)
new_v2_interface_methods: Append(ref SeriesRef, ls labels.Labels, st, t int64, v float64, h *histogram.Histogram, fh *histogram.FloatHistogram, opts AppendV2Options) (SeriesRef, error)
migration_pattern.migration_shim: LimitedAppenderV1 provides a bridge with Append(ref, l, t, v) and AppendHistogram(ref, l, t, h, fh) backed by AppenderV2. Use AppenderV2AsLimitedV1() helper.
